### Nexus - Zero-Dependency Reverse Proxy & API Gateway `[Completed]`
*Core Backend Engineer (Aug 2026 - Sep 2026)*
Production-grade reverse proxy and API gateway built strictly using Node.js standard library (`node:*` built-ins) without any third-party npm dependencies.
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js (`node:http`, `node:tls`, `node:crypto`), JavaScript
- **Key Highlights**:
  - Implemented TLS termination, dynamic path routing, health checks, round-robin load balancing, and rate limiting with zero external dependencies.
  - Built a live metrics dashboard and authentication verification layer directly in native Node.js streams.
  - Documented architectural design and performance characteristics in featured Hashnode article.
- **Links**: [Code Repo](https://github.com/kanchan-nath) | [Live Link](https://kanchannath.hashnode.dev/everything-i-d-normally-npm-install-building-a-reverse-proxy-from-node-s-standard-library)

*Backend Architect (Jan 2026 - Feb 2026)*

- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, BullMQ, FFmpeg, Cloudinary, JWT
- **Key Highlights**:
